scope: Preserved excluded source texts; no TRAIN use. Original working draft changed after overlap inspection; historical audit remains unchanged.

excluded.en: On this ferry, a folding bicycle counts as cabin luggage only if it is folded and placed inside a carrying bag. A bicycle with small wheels does not qualify merely because it takes up less space.
excluded.zh: 在这班渡轮上，折叠自行车只有折好并装进携行袋后才算作客舱行李。小轮自行车不会仅因占用空间较少就符合条件。
excluded.reason: Conservative exclusion: shares the core folding-bicycle/bag admission condition with old DEV v4-dev-030. Authored before looking at the old source, but not suitable as an independent TRAIN addition.

excluded.en: Toast the pumpkin seeds with their thin skins on, then let them cool on an uncovered tray. Covering the hot seeds traps steam and can soften them again.
excluded.zh: 保留薄皮烘香南瓜子，然后将它们放在未加盖的托盘上冷却。盖住热的南瓜子会困住蒸汽，可能使它们重新变软。
excluded.reason: Conservative exclusion: seed-toasting/cooling scenario too similar to old TRAIN v8-multi-017 to count as a new independent source.
